Given a task description consisting of a network topology T , broken configurations Cbroken, and violated specifications V , the agent dynamically retrieves relevant context of its own choice, proposes search-and-replace edits, and interacts with a verifier to see the state of unresolved specifications before submitting the final Cfix.
